quirks.body: Free NVIDIA-hosted API prototyping; not a fixed monthly credit allocation or unrestricted production offer. Shared account allowance, not per model. Text inference passed on 2026-10-24; tool and vision capabilities have not been separately verified. Development/testing only; do not advertise unrestricted free production access. Source: https://developer.nvidia.com/nim

quirks_resolved.body: NVIDIA NIM replaced its depleting trial credits with a recurring per-account rate limit (40 RPM default, varies by model), verified June 2026. The trial ToS still scopes usage to evaluation/prototyping, not production.
